name: @open-deutsch/plugin
description: Versioned Open Deutsch Codex plugin payload workspace.

scripts.plugin:install: pnpm --filter @open-deutsch/mcp-server... run build && pnpm --filter @open-deutsch/codex-client... run build && node scripts/plugin-lifecycle.mjs install
